title: An object store is an index of keys plus a fleet of disks
caption: The front end writes the bytes across zones, then records where they went; reads look up the key and stream the bytes back.

steps.text: PUT /bucket/photos/abc.jpg: a flat key, not a folder. The whole object goes in one request (or in parts).
The bytes are written to disks in several availability zones (replicas or erasure-coded fragments) before the PUT is acknowledged.
The index records key → locations, size and ETag. LIST by prefix is a range scan over this index.
GET with Range: bytes=0-1048575 looks up the key and streams just that slice, which is how video players seek.
